review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record idea, baseline/result, verdict and reason; consult that ledger before retrying the same proposal. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录想法、基准结果、结论理由，下次相同提案先查台账。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Bind grader results to the full expectation set
name_zh: 按完整预期结果核对评分
summary_en: Validate grade identities and reconstruct totals from the declared expectation set.
summary_zh: 确认评分对应正确样本，再按全部预期项重新计算总分。

sources.section: Bind grader results to the full expectation set

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Require one unique result per canonical expectation ID, retain canonical text and derive counts; reject missing/duplicate IDs or inconsistent integer summaries. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：每规范ID一个唯一结果，保留规范文字并派生计数，拒缺失重复ID或冲突整数摘要。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Review changes to the quality bar itself
name_zh: 同时评审代码和通过标准
summary_en: Review the validator as well as the implementation so green cannot be bought by weakening the contract.
summary_zh: 检查验证器是否被放宽，避免靠降低要求让测试通过。

sources.section: Review changes to the quality bar itself

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Compare baseline thresholds, skipped/deleted tests, removed assertions, suppressions, stubs and new exceptions; require explained scoped exceptions. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：比较基准阈值、跳过删除测试、移除断言、抑制、桩和新例外，例外须解释且限定。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 按调查问题选择协作方式
summary_en: Choose independent reports for a known artifact and interacting investigators for competing causal hypotheses.
summary_zh: 评审已知产物可独立出报告；排查相互竞争的原因需要调查者交流。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Ask whether the artifact is known or must be found; preserve independent judgments for verdicts, and require falsifiable evidence exchange before investigative convergence. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先问产物已知还是待找；判断保留独立性，调查收敛前交换可证伪证据。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Reference closure in the received artifact
name_zh: 交接后仍能找到全部引用文件
summary_en: Verify referenced material in the receiver installed layout rather than only the author repository.
summary_zh: 在接收方的实际目录结构中检查引用，不只在作者仓库里检查。

sources.section: Reference closure in the received artifact

Preserve package-relative resources across installation cache relocation

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: List mandatory references and resolve them from the containing artifact under the shipped/handed-off layout; package or remap missing dependencies. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：清点必需参考，从所在产物在交付布局解析；缺依赖则打包或改映射。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point
name_zh: 分清工作角色与协调入口
summary_en: Keep domain work in leaf roles and orchestration at the entry point that owns the decision.
summary_zh: 具体角色负责领域任务，拥有决策权的入口负责协调。

sources.section: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Distinguish reusable process, reviewer perspective and user-facing command; choose direct invocation for one lens and flat fan-out plus main merge for independent lenses. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：区别可复用流程、评审视角、面向用户命令；单视角直调，多独立视角扁平分发主合并。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 以实测基线逐步提高要求
summary_en: Adopt a measured nonregression direction when an arbitrary target would fail the inherited baseline.
summary_zh: 不使用会让现有基线必然失败的任意目标，先保证实测表现不退步。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record metric value, measurement conditions, allowed direction and tolerance; compare equivalent runs and update improved baselines. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录值、条件、允许方向及容差，比较等价运行，改善时更新基准。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 区分不同类型的测量证据
summary_en: Separate static potential-impact findings from lab, field and trace measurements.
summary_zh: 分别标明静态分析、实验室测试、真实用户数据和执行记录。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Select mode from available artifacts, label every populated value with its source kind, and leave unmeasured fields explicitly unmeasured. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按可用产物选模式，各值标来源类型，未测字段明确未测。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 排除正常波动后再判断改进
summary_en: Compare one change under equivalent measurement conditions and require signal beyond normal variance.
summary_zh: 在相同条件下比较单个变化，只有差异超过正常波动才认为有效。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Keep command, workload and budget constant; repeat measurements, preserve correctness gates and decide against the observed noise range. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：固定命令负载预算，重复测量，保留正确性门，再按噪声范围决定。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 反向路由测试也要去往正确 Skill
summary_en: A negative routing example must route to its intended owner, not merely avoid one wrong skill.
summary_zh: 测试“不该调用这个 Skill”时，还要确认请求被交给合适的替代者。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name the correct neighboring skill and require it to outrank the rejected candidate with nonzero match. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：命名正确相邻技能，并要求非零匹配且排序高于被拒候选。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 避免重复设置路由层
summary_en: Avoid stacking a full meta-router on top of a host that already selects the same skills natively.
summary_zh: 宿主已经能选择相同的 Skill 时，不再常驻一套完整的额外路由指令。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Detect the actual host discovery capability and choose one active routing authority; keep reusable skills available on demand. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：检测真实发现能力，只选一个有效路由权威，技能按需可用。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Protected content through an editable projection
name_zh: 通过引用编辑受保护内容
summary_en: Keep protected content in an authoritative store while the editing view contains explicit opaque references.
summary_zh: 受保护正文保存在权威库中，编辑视图只保留明确的引用。

sources.section: Protected content through an editable projection

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Preserve original bytes and identity, edit only the intended projection, then reconstruct and verify protected content and changed surroundings before applying. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：保留原字节身份，仅编辑指定投影，应用前重建并验受护内容与周边变化。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 先确定要回答的问题，再设置监控
summary_en: Choose instrumentation from the questions an operator must answer.
summary_zh: 根据操作人员需要判断什么，选择要记录的指标和信号。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name diagnostic questions first, then map each to an event, aggregate or path trace; omit signals with no declared use. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先命名诊断问题，再映事件、聚合或路径轨迹，无用途信号省略。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 先核实评审意见，再安排修复
summary_en: Treat reviewer output as hypotheses and classify against the actual artifact before acting.
summary_zh: 把评审结论当作待验证的判断，结合实际产物分类后再行动。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Check contract misread first, then actionable defect, accepted tradeoff and context-caused noise; fix the contract before repeating review when it caused the error. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先查契约误读，再查可行动缺陷、接受权衡、背景噪声；契约致误则先修契约再评审。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels
name_zh: 用不会执行内容的方式传递评审材料
summary_en: Preserve artifact text as data when invoking an external reviewer.
summary_zh: 调用外部评审工具时，让待审文本始终作为数据传入。

sources.section: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Write the full artifact/contract prompt to a file and feed stdin; verify the tool and use a read-only execution boundary. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：完整产物契约提示写文件，经标准输入传递；验证工具并用只读边界。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 分别检查任务完成和项目就绪
summary_en: Require the requested behavior and the standing project readiness bar separately.
summary_zh: 既验证本次要求的行为，也检查项目一贯的交付要求。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Keep per-task acceptance distinct from reusable quality/integration/operational gates and check both before completion. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：每任务验收与可复用质量集成运维门分开，完成前两者都核。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Reuse verification until its assumptions change
name_zh: 条件没变化时复用验证结果
summary_en: Repeat a successful check only when relevant code or baseline assumptions have changed.
summary_zh: 只有相关代码或基线假设变化后，才重跑已经通过的检查。

sources.section: Reuse verification until its assumptions change

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record command, artifact revision and scope; invalidate evidence on an edit affecting that check, not on nervousness alone. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录命令、产物修订和范围；影响检查的编辑使证据失效，而非仅因不安。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 验证监控通道本身能工作
summary_en: Check the telemetry path by generating a known signal and finding it through the intended channel.
summary_zh: 主动生成已知信号，确认能从预期的通道查到它。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Use an authorized isolated test to induce an error/event, trace its identifier and verify structured fields, labels, propagation and alert delivery. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：在已授权隔离测试诱发错误事件，追身份并核结构字段标签传播与报警送达。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Use a deadline independent of stream activity
name_zh: 为流式任务设置总时限
summary_en: Use a total operation deadline as well as inactivity detection so keepalives cannot occupy a worker indefinitely.
summary_zh: 除无活动超时外，还设置总截止时间，避免心跳让任务无限占用资源。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Start a non-resetting wall-clock budget for the case; classify expiry as a timeout, release local capacity, cap retries, and retain the underlying-operation identity. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：案例开始时设置不重置的时间预算；到期标为超时，释放本地容量，限制重试并保留远程操作身份。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Keep answer keys outside agent reach
name_zh: 不让被测 Agent 接触标准答案
summary_en: Make evaluation answers structurally unavailable to the system being tested, including history and earlier-trial artifacts.
summary_zh: 把答案与被测系统隔离，包括历史记录和前几轮生成的文件。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Give it the realistic symptom and allowed fixture; keep gold labels and grader data outside its accessible environment, remove leftover trial state, and check its actual access paths. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：只给真实症状和允许夹具；答案标签与评分数据放在可访问环境外，清理前次状态，检查实际访问路径。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Keep attempts, grades and traces coherent
name_zh: 把评分和记录绑定到同一次尝试
summary_en: Distinguish a scorable result from an attempt failure and keep each result’s grade, trace and usage bound to the same invocation.
summary_zh: 区分执行失败与可评分结果，确保分数、轨迹和用量属于同一次调用。

sources.section: No answer is not negative answer

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Key durable results by case and repetition; checkpoint completed invocations, record failed attempts separately with class and usage, and resume only missing scorable results. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按案例与重复次数保存结果；完成调用及时落盘，失败尝试另记类别与用量，只补跑缺少可评分结果的槽位。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Separate build variance from scoring variance
name_zh: 区分生成波动与评分波动
summary_en: When a prompt builds an artifact that is later evaluated, measure build variability separately from repeated scoring of one artifact.
summary_zh: 分别测量每次生成产物的差异，以及对同一产物重复评分的差异。

sources.section: Stochastic artifact build and propagated control

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Rebuild the unchanged baseline independently, score each build with the same query design, and preserve build identity in candidate comparisons; estimate uncertainty at the levels where randomness occurs. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：独立重建未改动基线，对每次构建使用相同查询设计，候选比较保留构建身份；在随机性实际发生的层级估计不确定性。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 保留完整的响应结构
summary_en: Retain structured response state for continuation and derive human-readable text as a separate view.
summary_zh: 续接任务时使用完整的结构化响应，把可读文本作为单独视图。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Store the full envelope with typed blocks and matching identities; extract text for display while returning the unchanged required state on continuation. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：完整保存类型化块和匹配身份；显示时抽取文字，续跑时按契约返回未修改的必要状态。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 根据具体结论提出核验问题
summary_en: Attach optional verification questions to actual claims and assumptions, and omit them when the user already requested that verification.
summary_zh: 问题应对应真实的结论和假设；用户已经要求核验时直接执行。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Answer the task first; point a brief follow-up at the exact assumption, its evidence source and missing context. If verification was requested, perform it inline instead. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先完成任务；简短追问明确假设、证据与缺失背景。已要求核验时在正文完成。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Retain full validation beside a compatible schema
name_zh: 简化 schema 时保留完整业务校验
summary_en: Keep the full business validation contract when a host accepts only a reduced schema representation.
summary_zh: 宿主只接受部分 schema 特性时，仍要在其他位置执行完整校验。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Maintain the original validator, derive a compatible wire schema, and validate the returned data against every removed constraint before downstream use. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：保留原验证器，派生兼容传输模式；下游使用前核验被移除的每项约束。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Preserve coordinate units through tool handoffs
name_zh: 工具交接时保留坐标单位
summary_en: Carry units, dimensions and origin with positions; normalize mixed coordinate sources before a downstream operation.
summary_zh: 位置数据同时传递单位、尺寸和原点；混用不同坐标来源时先转换。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Record page identity, source dimensions, units and origin; convert pixel coordinates to the common page system, then apply the consumer’s origin transform and inspect the result. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录页身份、来源尺寸、单位和原点；先把像素转换为统一页坐标，再按消费者原点转换并检查结果。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Regrade all variants after a criterion change
name_zh: 评分规则变化后重新评估所有方案
summary_en: When a metric or grader changes, apply it consistently to stored outputs from every compared variant before recommending a winner.
summary_zh: 用新指标对所有候选的已保存输出重新评分，再推荐最佳方案。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Version the new criterion, regrade frozen outputs for baseline and all candidates, retain old-versus-new comparisons, and reconsider the winner if rankings change. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：版本化新标准，对基线和全部候选的冻结输出重评，保留新旧比较；排名变化时重新考虑赢家。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 区分 Agent 定义版本与运行实例
summary_en: Reuse a versioned agent definition while giving each execution its own run identity.
summary_zh: 复用有版本的定义，但每次执行使用独立的运行 ID。

sources.section: Versioned reusable definition and per-run instances

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Create or update the definition in setup, persist its identity and version, and create runs that explicitly reference the approved version; treat live-run overrides separately. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：设置阶段创建或更新定义，保存身份与版本；运行明确引用获批版本，实时运行覆盖另行记录。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Move deterministic loop steps into code
name_zh: 确定性的步骤交给普通代码
summary_en: Use ordinary code for steps fully determined by their inputs and retain model judgment for the ambiguous remainder.
summary_zh: 输入已完全决定结果的步骤用代码处理，只让模型判断有歧义的部分。

sources.section: Mechanical work and retained adaptive judgment

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Map call sites to responsibilities; implement fixed normalization and arithmetic in code, then send only ambiguous descriptions and needed context to the judgment step. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：逐个调用点映射职责；代码实现固定归一与算术，只把有歧义描述和所需上下文交给判断步骤。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Use fresh no-change controls after drift
name_zh: 条件变化后重新设置无改动对照
summary_en: When execution conditions change, compare a candidate against a contemporaneous unchanged control rather than only an old baseline number.
summary_zh: 环境变化时，用同一时期的原方案作对照，避免只与历史分数比较。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Record the environment and artifact fingerprints; rerun the unchanged control under current conditions, rebuilding any stochastic intermediate artifact, then compare the candidate in that same setting. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录环境和产物指纹；在当前条件重跑未改动对照，重建随机中间产物，再在相同设置比较候选。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Grade the environment left by an agent
name_zh: 检查 Agent 操作后的实际环境
summary_en: For an agent that changes an environment, score the resulting state and use transcripts for explicit process constraints.
summary_zh: 任务会改变环境时，应评分最终状态；对话记录用于检查过程要求。

name_zh: 先说明效果的用途，再添加效果

summary_zh: 添加动画或视觉效果前，说明它要向用户传达什么。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Require a reason tied to hierarchy, narrative, feedback or state change; omit effects with only decorative rationale. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：理由关联层级、叙事、反馈或状态变化，纯装饰理由则省略。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Match reference granularity to inspection needs
name_zh: 按检查需求拆分参考资料

summary_zh: 把密集参考拆成合适的单元，同时保留后续检查需要的细节。

sources.section: Match reference granularity to inspection needs

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Count requested units, give each a readable artifact, and add detail views only where inspection is uncertain. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：清点所需单元，各有可读产物，不明确处才加细节视图。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 改版前盘点必须保留的行为
summary_en: Classify redesign intent and inventory nonvisual contracts before changing presentation.
summary_zh: 先明确改版目的，并检查路由、状态和交互等非视觉要求。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Detect preserve versus overhaul, record brand/content/routes/tracking/accessibility, then apply focused visual changes within that contract. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：区别保留与大改，记录品牌内容路由跟踪可访问，再在契约内做聚焦视觉变化。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 交接设计变量的名称、值和用途
summary_en: Express design tokens as semantic names, exact values and functional roles.
summary_zh: 用明确的语义名称、精确数值和功能角色描述设计 token。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Pair a human description with a machine-usable value and where it applies, then use the same vocabulary throughout the handoff. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：人类描述配机器可用值及适用处，交接中词汇一致。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Inspect the specimen before translating it
name_zh: 实现参考设计前先检查样本
summary_en: Extract an explicit visual contract before coding from a reference artifact.
summary_zh: 从参考文件中提取明确的视觉要求，再开始编码。

sources.section: Inspect the specimen before translating it

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Inspect readable text, relative typography, spacing, colors, components and uncertainties; implement against that extracted contract. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：检查可读文字、相对字体、间距、颜色、组件及未知点；按抽取契约实现。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 避免版式泄露测试答案
summary_en: Keep an assessment from leaking its answer through presentation differences.
summary_zh: 让不同选项的呈现方式保持一致，避免从布局看出正确答案。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Make option lengths and formatting comparable, then give feedback based on the tested skill. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：选项长度格式可比，再按所测技能提供反馈。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 主动验证保护规则能拦住违规
summary_en: Verify a guardrail rejects an intentional violation, then returns to clean success.
summary_zh: 构造一次故意违规的操作，确认被阻止，再恢复干净的成功状态。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Observe pass on allowed input, fail on a temporary forbidden input, and pass after removal. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：允许输入通过，临时禁止输入失败，移除后再通过。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 删除抽象层，推演复杂度会去哪
summary_en: Challenge an abstraction by predicting where complexity would go if it vanished.
summary_zh: 在保留一个抽象前，判断移除它后职责和复杂度会如何变化。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Trace caller obligations after hypothetical deletion; retain hidden reusable behavior and collapse pure pass-through layers. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：追踪假想删除后的调用责任；保留隐藏的可复用行为，合并纯转发层。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 用稳定的行为约定交接 Agent 任务
summary_en: Describe behavior and named interfaces instead of volatile file locations in delayed task handoffs.
summary_zh: 交接长期任务时说明行为和接口，避免依赖容易变化的文件位置。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: State current/desired behavior, independently testable acceptance criteria, interface names and exclusions. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：明确当前/目标行为、独立可测验收、接口名和排除项。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Environment as instruction source of truth
name_zh: 实时查询可执行的环境事实
summary_en: Avoid maintaining a stale prose cache of cheap executable environment facts.
summary_zh: 对便宜且可直接检查的环境信息，避免维护容易过期的文字副本。

sources.section: Environment as instruction source of truth

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Reference inspectable config/help for scripts and paths; document only unwritten conventions or expensive lookups. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：脚本路径查配置或帮助，只记录隐含约定或昂贵查询。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 只把有证据的学习成果存入记忆
summary_en: Store demonstrated knowledge separately from material merely covered.
summary_zh: 区分已经证明掌握的知识和只是接触过的材料。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record demonstrated use, explicit prior-knowledge depth or corrected misconceptions; supersede contrary records instead of erasing history. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记实际运用、明确先验深度或纠正误解；相反记录以取代标记保留历史。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 用分阶段迁移保留兼容性
summary_en: Use expand/migrate/contract stages when a broad mechanical change cannot land in independent vertical slices.
summary_zh: 无法独立逐项交付的大规模修改，按扩展、迁移、收缩三个阶段推进。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Introduce both forms, migrate callers in bounded batches, and remove the old form only after all callers migrate. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：新旧形式并存，分批迁移调用者，全部迁完才删旧形式。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Explicit partial and invalid fixture intent
name_zh: 区分不完整样本与故意无效的输入
summary_en: Distinguish incomplete valid fixtures from intentionally invalid input.
summary_zh: 测试中明确哪些样本是有效但不完整，哪些用于验证错误处理。

sources.section: Explicit partial and invalid fixture intent

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Use explicit fixture constructors for partial, invalid and exact shapes instead of erasing all types with the same cast. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：部分、非法和完整形状分别用明确构造器，不统一强制擦除类型。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 并行执行就绪任务，逐个集成结果
summary_en: Run independent dependency-ready tasks in isolated contexts and serialize their integration.
summary_zh: 依赖已满足的独立任务可隔离执行，合并时按顺序验证。

sources.section: landed-commit frontier and isolated-worktree verification limits

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Compute readiness from what has landed on the integration branch; dispatch that frontier and merge one result at a time. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按集成分支已落地任务计算就绪前沿，调度该前沿并逐项合并。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Mechanics to checks, judgment to review
name_zh: 机械规则交给检查工具，判断留给评审
summary_en: Turn syntactic mistakes into deterministic checks and reserve prose rules for judgment.
summary_zh: 语法和结构问题用自动检查处理，文字规则重点说明需要判断的部分。

sources.section: Mechanics to checks, judgment to review

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Inspect existing checks, repair their wiring first, then encode fixed patterns in the cheapest local guardrail. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先检查现有检查并修接线，再用最便宜本地护栏编码固定模式。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 按实际后果选择变更证据
summary_en: Review a change through observed behavior plus reversibility of its real-world consequences.
summary_zh: 既检查行为，也考虑真实后果是否可恢复，再决定评审深度。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Show before/after evidence, name one-way effects and identify affected callers or users. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：展示前后证据，列不可逆影响及受影响调用者用户。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 用一次性原型回答具体问题
summary_en: Choose the prototype artifact by the uncertainty it must resolve and expose relevant state.
summary_zh: 根据尚未确定的问题选择原型形式，并暴露需要观察的状态。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Distinguish logic/state from visual uncertainty; minimize setup, use scratch state and preserve the question and verdict. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：区别逻辑状态与视觉问题，最小启动成本，使用临时状态并保存问题和结论。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 前提确定后再问下一轮问题
summary_en: Ask only decisions whose prerequisites have already settled, then recompute the next round.
summary_zh: 只询问前置条件已经明确的决策，收到答案后重新安排下一轮。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Treat answers and factual explorations as prerequisite nodes; unresolved nodes block only their dependents. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：答案和事实探索均为依赖节点，未定节点仅阻塞下游。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Question the knowledge owner through a send brief
name_zh: 找到真正掌握信息的人
summary_en: Ask the requester who holds missing knowledge and what decision needs it, then target the actual owner.
summary_zh: 先确认缺什么知识、谁掌握它，以及哪个决策需要答案，再组织询问。

sources.section: Question the knowledge owner through a send brief

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Interview recipient/context and required return, map every required fact to one fillable question ordered by decision importance. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：询问接收人背景和所需答复，每个所需事实映射成一个可填问题并按决策重要度排序。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 把概念、规则与例外放在一起
summary_en: Keep one concept definition, decision rules and exceptions together after selecting its disclosure tier.
summary_zh: 选定信息层级后，将同一概念的定义、判断规则和例外集中说明。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Separate ordered steps from reference, disclose branch-specific reference, and group each concept under one heading. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：区分步骤与参考，分支参考按需披露，每概念同一标题组织。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 按概念记录被否决的方案
summary_en: Recall substantive rejected concepts without poisoning that memory with already implemented requests.
summary_zh: 记住实质上被否决的想法，不把已经执行的用户要求混入拒绝记录。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Match by concept, ask whether rationale still holds, and keep rejections distinct from built features and temporary deferrals. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按概念匹配，复核理由仍成立，并区别已实现与临时推迟。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Repair the missing premise before shortening
name_zh: 先补充前提，再压缩解释
summary_en: Treat comprehension failure as a missing-context problem before optimizing word count.
summary_zh: 读者没理解时先找缺少的背景，避免只缩短文字而留下同样的障碍。

sources.section: Repair the missing premise before shortening

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Restate the decision in shared nouns and supply the premise the reader lacks, then trim redundancy. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：用共享名词重述决定，补读者缺失前提，再删冗余。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Reread shared artifacts before incremental writes
name_zh: 继续写共享文件前先重读
summary_en: Preserve intervening human edits while materializing agreed work incrementally.
summary_zh: 增量写入前读取最新内容，保留其间用户做的修改。

sources.section: Reread shared artifacts before incremental writes

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Read current disk contents before each append or targeted rewrite; keep the input corpus separate. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：每次追加或定向改写先重读磁盘；原材料单独保存。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 按依赖类型选择验证替代方案
summary_en: Choose verification substitutes according to the dependency controlled by the module.
summary_zh: 根据模块控制的是哪种依赖，选择合适的模拟或替代检查。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Distinguish in-process, local-substitutable, remote-owned and true external dependencies before choosing real stand-ins, ports or mocks. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先区别进程内、本地可替代、远端自有和真正外部，再选真实替身、端口或模拟。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Compare structural variants in shared context
name_zh: 在真实环境中比较设计方案
summary_en: Compare design alternatives inside the real host context and hold data constant.
summary_zh: 把方案放到实际使用环境里比较，并保持测试数据一致。

sources.section: Compare structural variants in shared context

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Vary structure through a shareable selector on one route while retaining host navigation, density and read-only data. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：同一路由通过可分享选择器变结构，保留导航、密度和只读数据。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 用不同约束探索不同方案
summary_en: Generate alternatives under intentionally different constraints instead of multiplying identical proposals.
summary_zh: 主动改变设计条件，避免得到多个几乎相同的提案。

sources.section: Spec Analysis / Parallel Deployment / Uniqueness via Assignment

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Give each independent designer a different optimization objective, a shared vocabulary and the same required output schema. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：独立设计者各有优化目标，共享词汇与输出结构。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Keep tool roots separate from project roots
name_zh: 区分工具目录和项目目录
summary_en: Resolve installed helper code from its skill base while resolving project artifacts from the declared project working directory.
summary_zh: 工具代码从 Skill 安装目录查找，项目文件从声明的工作目录解析。

sources.section: Skill base versus project working directory

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Name both roots; invoke the installed helper by its resolved path without changing the project cwd, and resolve its inputs and outputs according to the helper contract. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：明确两种根；使用解析后的工具绝对路径执行，保持项目cwd，按契约解析输入输出。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Persist a master design system with page-specific overrides
name_zh: 集中保存全局设计规则
summary_en: Keep shared design rules in one project master and persist page-specific deviations separately for later retrieval.
summary_zh: 共享规则只维护一份，页面特有的差异另外记录，方便后续读取。

sources.section: Persist Design System (Master + Overrides Pattern) and context-aware retrieval

review.reason_en: Retain the durable sparse-delta retrieval contract: a project master plus page-only deviations, explicit field precedence and missing-page fallback. This differs from aesthetic exception selection and from assembling prompt adapters; the teaching fixture resolves the source's underspecified merge semantics without claiming upstream runtime verification.
review.reason_zh: 保留持久化稀疏差异的检索契约：项目主文件、只含页面偏差的文件、明确字段优先级与缺页回退。它区别于审美例外选择和提示适配器拼装；教学用例补全源文档未说明的合并语义，不声称核验了上游运行行为。

name_en: Verify a retrieved UI recommendation before reuse
name_zh: 复用界面建议前先核对适用性
summary_en: Treat a retrieved UI suggestion as provisional until its scope and identity fit the request.
summary_zh: 检索到的建议先当作候选，确认适用范围和对象符合当前需求。

sources.section: Select smallest search mode and verify query/result fit

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Choose the smallest applicable search mode, express one intent with two to five terms, then verify the result's domain/category and top item's identity and applicability. Retry once when needed, label any fallback, and do not persist unverified output. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：选择最小适用搜索模式，用2至5个词表达一个意图；随后核对结果的领域/类别以及首条内容的身份和适用性。必要时只重试一次，标明回退结果，并且不保存未经核验的输出。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Check privacy and evidence usefulness separately
name_zh: 分别检查隐私和证据完整性
summary_en: Verify that an export is scrubbed and independently verify that its remaining evidence still supports its claims.
summary_zh: 导出时既确认敏感信息已清除，也确认剩余证据仍能支撑结论。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Audit all exported files for sensitive values, then resolve each finding to included evidence; reconcile files and verify the final archive matches the reviewed set. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：审核全部导出文件的敏感值，再把各发现对应到随包证据，协调文件并验证压缩包与审核集合一致。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Record reversible decisions with their rationale and cost
name_zh: 记录决策理由和改错成本
summary_en: Record an authorized implementation decision, its evidence and cost if wrong, then include it in the final handoff.
summary_zh: 记录已授权的选择、依据和判断错误后的代价，并写入交接说明。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Resolve within authorized reversible scope using the spec, record the ruling and its rework cost, carry it to affected briefs and expose it in the final report. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：在已授权可逆范围内按规格解决，记录判断及返工代价，同步相关说明并在最终报告披露。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Preserve linkage with stable redaction placeholders
name_zh: 用一致的脱敏占位符保留关联
summary_en: Use consistent substitutions across an export while retaining safe identity and evidence structure.
summary_zh: 同一敏感对象始终使用相同替代值，同时保留安全的关联结构。
